title: The Service Pistol
logline: A disgraced veteran asks a pilot to recover their confiscated service pistol from a wealthy collector's touring exhibition so they can be buried with it.

roles.description: Old, tired, deeply ashamed of the retreat that ended their career.
Wealthy, condescending, views war memorabilia as a neat aesthetic.
A massive luxury cruiser repurposed as a floating military history gallery.
A quiet, crumbling memorial station in a dead system.
A high-end auction house that deals in seized assets and memorabilia.

public_situation: The {role:smug_collector} is touring the system in their {role:museum_ship}, displaying the sidearm of a disgraced fleet commander.
private_truth: The veteran pawned the pistol decades ago to pay off debts after being discharged. Now terminally ill, they want it back to be buried with it.

beats.public_change: The museum ship opens its doors to the public for a grand exhibition.

missions.reason: The veteran hires the pilot to deliver ferrite to patch up the memorial dock's hull, preparing a resting place.
missions.private_fact: The collector ignores the memorial and prepares to leave the system.

beats.public_change: The veteran is publicly denied entry to the exhibition.

missions.reason: The veteran begs the pilot to scan the ship's security grid to find a weakness in the display case.
missions.private_fact: The scan reveals the display case is wired to the ship's main drive; the only way to get the pistol safely is to disable the ship first.

beats.public_change: The museum ship prepares to leave the system.

missions.reason: The veteran asks the pilot to attack the museum ship and disable its engines so they can board it.
missions.private_fact: The collector hails the pilot in a panic, offering double the pistol's auction value in credits to escort the ship out of the system.

resolutions.summary: The veteran boards the ship, reclaims the pistol, and passes away at the memorial dock. The collector is humiliated.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot disabled a museum ship so an old veteran could reclaim their service pistol.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the collector's offer.
resolutions.summary: The ship escapes safely. The veteran dies in shame. The pilot gets rich but is haunted by the betrayal.
The museum ship leaves the system unimpeded. The veteran lives out their final days in obscurity.

loose_threads.detail: The serial number on the pistol matches a batch of weapons supposedly destroyed in a classified fleet operation.
The collector's manifest shows they bought the pistol using funds from a known pirate syndicate shell account.

radio_hooks: Museum ship exhibition draws massive crowds.
{role:disgraced_veteran} banned from the exhibition over 'disorderly conduct'.

voice_direction.disgraced_veteran: Slow, raspy, speaks with immense regret.
